verdict.rationale: Mollie's hosted checkout is documented as a single integration where 'customer can select their payment method of choice' (mollie-docs-21), and Apple Pay is explicitly called out as a checkout button option (mollie-docs-35), supporting the core 'one integration, many methods' claim. However, the evidence pack never explicitly names Google Pay, bank redirects (iDEAL/SEPA/Bancontact), or BNPL options (Klarna/Riverty) as available methods within this single integration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Google Pay support, bank redirect methods, and BNPL options within the same checkout integration.
